meta.name: search-console
meta.description: Query and operate connected Google Search Console properties through NotFair MCP. Use for live GSC query or page performance, clicks, impressions, CTR, position, traffic changes, indexing status, URL inspection, sitemap reads or approved sitemap submission/removal, and Search Console MCP setup. Route full-site SEO audits to seo-analysis.

copy.tagline: 查询Google搜索数据,掌握流量与收录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你运营网站,需要查看搜索流量和收录情况
copy.tagline_en: Query Google search performance data to track traffic and indexing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and need to track its Google search traffic and indexing

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 查询已连接的 Google Search Console 账户,获取点击、展示、CTR、平均排名,检查 URL 索引状态,并读取或经批准后提交/删除站点地图。完整 SEO 审计转交 seo-analysis。
howto.when: 当您查询 Google 搜索表现(如点击、展示)、检查 URL 索引状态,或管理站点地图(读取/提交/删除)等场景时触发。

say.text: 查一下 example.com 最近 30 天的点击和展示数据。
检查一下 https://example.com/page 的索引状态。
say.note: Claude 会进行 URL 检查,报告是否被索引。
需要你确认属性和 URL 后才提交。

howto.what_en: Via NotFair MCP, this skill lets Claude query Google Search Console accounts: clicks, impressions, CTR, position, indexing checks, and approved sitemap submission/removal. Stops if unauthorized; full-site audits go to seo-analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to query Google search performance (e.g., clicks, impressions), check URL indexing status, or manage sitemaps (submit/delete).

say_en.text: Check clicks and impressions for example.com in the last 30 days.
say_en.note: Claude will pull and summarize data from Search Console.

say_en.text: Check the indexing status of https://example.com/page.
say_en.note: Claude will run URL inspection and report if indexed.
You need to confirm the property and URL before submission.
